faq.q: Who is Abeer Nasir?
faq.a: Abeer Nasir is a Generative AI Specialist and Digital Marketing Specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan. He started learning Generative AI in 2023 and has since helped e-commerce and D2C brands grow with Meta Ads, Shopify, and AI automation. He believes in real numbers, not vanity metrics — and works directly with every client himself.

faq.q: What is Open Agent?
faq.a: Open Agent is a focused, hands-on digital marketing and AI automation practice founded by Abeer Nasir in 2023. Unlike traditional agencies that assign junior account managers, Open Agent means you work directly with Abeer. No layers, no handoffs, no middlemen. Just direct access to the person running your campaigns.

faq.q: How is Open Agent different from other agencies?
faq.a: Three things: (1) You work directly with Abeer — not a junior account manager. (2) Strategies are practical and measured, not theoretical. Every campaign has documented outcomes and real numbers. (3) Pricing is transparent — Starter PKR 30K, Premium PKR 50K, Pro PKR 80K — no hidden fees, and a 4-day money-back guarantee.

faq.q: What services do you offer?
faq.a: Eight service lines: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Shopify Development, AI Automation, AI Agents (chatbots), AI Content, Web Development, Google & Meta Paid Ads, and Social Media Management. You can pick one or bundle multiple.

faq.q: What are your rates in USD?
faq.a: Starter: ~$100/month (PKR 30,000), Premium: ~$175/month (PKR 50,000), Pro: ~$280/month (PKR 80,000). International payments via Wise or PayPal. Each plan has a 4-day money-back guarantee.

faq.q: Do you work with US-based businesses?
faq.a: Yes. Abeer works remotely with US e-commerce and D2C founders. Communication is over WhatsApp, email, or video call. Deliverables are aligned to US time zones. Several US clients have been served successfully.

faq.q: Do you work with UK or UAE clients?
faq.a: Yes — Abeer works with clients globally, including the UK, UAE, KSA, and Canada. Time zone differences are managed through async communication (WhatsApp, email) and scheduled calls. Response time is typically within a few hours.

faq.q: What results have you delivered?
faq.a: Key documented wins: (1) 30 qualified sales for a perfume D2C brand with PKR 1,000 ad spend — ~3x ROAS. (2) 6 qualified leads for a local service business with PKR 2,000 budget. (3) An AI automation that saves a founder 2 hours every day on lead follow-ups. (4) Shopify store optimization that improved conversion flow for a beauty brand.

faq.q: Can I see case studies with real numbers?
faq.a: Absolutely. The case studies page (open-agent-eight.vercel.app/case-studies.html) documents real campaigns with actual numbers — ad spend, results, ROAS, timeline, and approach. Client names are kept private per agreement, but the numbers are real.

faq.q: Do you have client testimonials?
faq.a: Yes. Clients have said: 'Abeer understood our perfume brand better than agencies that charged 10x' (S. Khan, Beauty brand owner), 'The AI automation saves me 2 hours every day' (M. Ali, E-commerce founder), 'Finally someone who explains in plain words and shows numbers' (R. Ahmed, D2C startup). More testimonials are available on request.

faq.q: How long until I see results from Meta Ads?
faq.a: Early signals appear within 1-2 weeks. Meaningful ROAS data takes 3-4 weeks. Abeer optimizes daily — testing audiences, creatives, and bids. The first week is about finding what works; weeks 2-4 are about scaling what works.

faq.q: What budget do I need to start Meta Ads?
faq.a: Abeer has run effective campaigns on budgets as low as PKR 1,000 (for testing). For a meaningful campaign, he recommends starting at PKR 30,000-50,000/month. Small budgets force discipline and creative focus — which often converts better than big budgets with lazy targeting.

faq.q: Do you build AI chatbots?
faq.a: Yes — custom chatbots and virtual assistants built on ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They can be trained on your business data, integrated into your website, connected to WhatsApp, and set up to handle support, lead gen, or bookings. This chatbot you're talking to right now is exactly that!

faq.q: Can you build a chatbot like this for my website?
faq.a: Yes! This chatbot is a custom-built AI agent trained on Abeer's personal data. Abeer can build the same for your business — trained on your products, services, FAQs, and brand voice. It runs on pure HTML/CSS/JS with no backend needed. Contact him on WhatsApp to discuss.

faq.q: What platforms can a chatbot be integrated with?
faq.a: Website (embed via HTML snippet), WhatsApp Business API, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, and Slack. Each integration is custom-built based on your needs.

faq.q: What AI automation can you build?
faq.a: Lead capture & follow-up sequences, automated email/SMS campaigns, CRM contact management, reporting dashboards, social media scheduling, e-commerce order notifications, and more. Built with Zapier, Make, or n8n — no code required, easy to modify.

faq.q: Can you automate my lead follow-ups?
faq.a: Yes — this is one of Abeer's most popular automations. Leads come in from ads or WhatsApp, get an instant acknowledgement message, are tagged by source and interest, and receive timed follow-up nudges. Everything is personalized using AI so it sounds human, not robotic.

faq.q: How long does it take to build an automation?
faq.a: Simple automations (like lead capture + WhatsApp notification) can be built in 1-2 days. Complex workflows (multi-step with CRM integration, conditional logic, and reporting) take 3-7 days. Abeer works in sprints and you see progress as it's built.

faq.q: What can you do with Shopify?
faq.a: Full store setup from scratch, theme customization, product page optimization, checkout flow improvement, mobile optimization, app integrations, and AI-assisted product descriptions. Abeer specializes in making Shopify stores convert better.

faq.q: Can you help my perfume or beauty brand?
faq.a: Yes — this is one of Abeer's core niches. He has worked with perfume and beauty D2C brands on Meta Ads campaigns that drove real sales, Shopify store optimization, and AI-assisted content. He understands the fragrance industry's unique marketing angles and audience psychology.

faq.q: What industries do you work with?
faq.a: Primary focus: D2C e-commerce, perfume & beauty, fashion & apparel, local service businesses, and Shopify brands. Abeer is most effective with brands that want practical growth strategies and measurable outcomes.

faq.q: Do you work with SaaS companies or real estate?
faq.a: Abeer's primary expertise is in D2C e-commerce and local service businesses. While the skills (Meta Ads, AI automation, web dev) are transferable, his strongest results and niche experience are in e-commerce/D2C. For SaaS or real estate, a discovery call would help determine fit.

faq.q: Can you redesign my existing website?
faq.a: Yes. Abeer can audit your current site, identify conversion friction points, and redesign with mobile-first, fast-loading principles. The same stack used for open-agent-eight.vercel.app.

faq.q: Do you do one-time projects or only ongoing?
faq.a: Both. Ongoing monthly retainers are the primary model (to maintain and optimize campaigns). But one-time projects are available — website builds, automation setup, chatbot creation, or store optimization. Contact Abeer to discuss scope.

faq.q: How do we communicate?
faq.a: Fastest: WhatsApp (+92 370 3159642). Otherwise email (nasirmeo5533@gmail.com or abeerinfo5566@gmail.com). For paid clients: dedicated WhatsApp channel, weekly/bi-weekly calls depending on plan, and monthly strategy reviews.

faq.q: How quickly do you respond?
faq.a: Typically within 1-2 hours on WhatsApp during working hours (PKT, UTC+5). Email within 4 hours. Premium and Pro clients get priority response within 30 minutes.

faq.q: What's your refund policy?
faq.a: 4-day money-back guarantee on all plans. If you're not satisfied within the first 4 days, you get a full refund of the service fee — no questions asked. This means zero risk to try working with Abeer.

faq.q: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.a: Yes. No lock-in contracts. Month-to-month engagement. Cancel or pause anytime. Abeer believes you stay because of results, not because of a contract.

faq.q: Do you sign NDAs?
faq.a: Yes — Abeer is happy to sign NDAs and confidentiality agreements. Client privacy is taken seriously.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: Within Pakistan: Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, JazzCash. International: Wise, PayPal. Contact Abeer for specific payment arrangements.

faq.q: Do you have a portfolio I can see?
faq.a: Yes — visit open-agent-eight.vercel.app/portfolio.html for visual samples of ad creatives, store designs, and content work. Case studies with real numbers are at open-agent-eight.vercel.app/case-studies.html.

faq.q: Can I talk to past clients?
faq.a: Abeer can share client references upon request (with client permission). Some client names and details are kept private, but he's happy to arrange a conversation with past clients who've agreed to be references.

faq.q: What tools and platforms do you use?
faq.a: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Shopify, Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini APIs, Canva, Google Analytics, WhatsApp Business API, HTML/CSS/JS, Vercel, GitHub.

faq.q: What's your content strategy approach?
faq.a: Abeer focuses on content that converts: ad creatives with strong hooks and clear offers, social posts that tell stories, email sequences that nurture leads, and blog content that builds authority. All content is either AI-assisted or AI-generated with human refinement.

faq.q: Do you do Google Ads too?
faq.a: Yes — Google Search Ads, Google Display, and Shopping Ads are part of the 'Paid Ads — Google & Meta' service. Full-funnel paid media across both platforms.

faq.q: Do you create ad creatives?
faq.a: Yes — Abeer develops ad creative concepts and either creates them directly (using Canva, AI tools) or works with your designer to execute the vision. Creative strategy is included in all plans.

faq.q: What's your experience with small budgets?
faq.a: Abeer has run successful campaigns on very small budgets: PKR 1,000 for a perfume brand (30 inquiries) and PKR 2,000 for a local service (6 leads). He believes small budgets force discipline — you can't waste money on lazy targeting, so every rupee has to work harder.

faq.q: How do you measure success?
faq.a: For ads: ROAS (return on ad spend), cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rate. For automation: time saved, leads captured, response time. For Shopify: conversion rate, average order value, cart abandonment rate. Everything is tracked and reported in plain English — no jargon.

faq.q: Do you offer consulting or strategy calls?
faq.a: Yes — the first strategy call is free (20 min). For deeper consulting, Abeer offers paid strategy sessions. Contact him on WhatsApp to discuss.

faq.q: Can I hire you for a specific project?
faq.a: Yes — one-time projects available for website builds, automation setup, chatbot creation, or store optimization. Contact Abeer with your scope and he'll provide a fixed-price quote.

faq.q: Do you document your work?
faq.a: Yes — all workflows, ad account structures, and automations are documented. You're never locked in, and you keep access to everything built.

faq.q: Are you on LinkedIn?
faq.a: Yes — linkedin.com/in/abeer-nasir-3052b628a. Connect with Abeer for updates on AI, digital marketing, and growth strategies.

faq.a: X/Twitter: @Abeergrowth, Facebook: Abeer Nasir, Instagram: @growthbot_02, LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/abeer-nasir-3052b628a

faq.a: Abeer has been working with e-commerce and D2C brands since 2023. His focus areas: Meta Ads for product sales, Shopify optimization, AI-assisted product content, and automation for post-purchase follow-ups. The perfume and beauty niche is where he has the deepest experience.
